message.content: {"label":"insufficient","reason":"The passages do not establish a complete greenshoe/overallotment arrangement for all three IPOs. Uber mentions a potential 27,000,000 shares from selling stockholders but does not provide the greenshoe exercise period or who actually sells the additional shares; Airbnb describes a directed share program rather than a greenshoe; DoorDash provides no greenshoe information.","supported_requirements":[],"missing_requirements":["DoorDash: greenshoe/overallotment option existence, share limit, exercise period, and seller of additional shares.","Uber: greenshoe/overallotment option existence, exercise period, and confirmation of seller.","Airbnb: greenshoe/overallotment option existence, share limit, exercise period, and seller."],"concerns":["Uber’s text implies an option to purchase additional shares by underwriters/selling stockholders but omits a period and who sells the additional shares.","Airbnb’s directed share program is not a greenshoe and does not answer the greenshoe question.","DoorDash’s materials do not mention any greenshoe/overallotment feature."]}
